column1: # Zed file-type association catalog consumed by installer_apply_associations.
# identifier is a UTI or a filename extension; failure ∈ report|ignore, where
# "ignore" is best-effort because Launch Services does not know every
# identifier on every macOS version. A "-" label falls back to the identifier.
# Role "editor" throughout — never "all" — so that .html/.htm do not claim the
# viewer role macOS maps to the default web browser, which would trigger the
# system confirmation dialog asking to change the default browser. public.html
# is omitted from the broad rows below for the same reason.
# Applying this catalog is a run-once step, so editing a row changes what the
# next apply would set without setting it. DOTFILES_RESET=zed-associations dot
# for the same shape in the Dock catalog.
